findings.summary: The state dict is captured at line 649 before the new fp32 upcast, so with cpu_ram_efficient_loading and mixed precision rank 0 broadcasts bf16/fp16 tensors while other ranks allocate fp32 receive buffers, which can hang, crash or corrupt weights.
The new tests mock fully_shard and set cpu_ram_efficient_loading=False, so they never exercise the broken dtype-mismatch broadcast path.
